scope: Boundary review, explicitly separate from 629 complete first-party source reviews. No complete vendor-source/visual/legal assurance.

active-meta.method: Parse every JSON; source/importer/UUID/subMeta/redirect checks; compare runtime bundle paths and compressed UUIDs.
active-meta.conclusion: 435 active metadata entries, 393 file pairs and 42 directories; no active UUID collision or missing source/meta. Metadata validation is not every Cocos renderer behavior.

archived-meta.method: Inspect all 3 JSONs and excluded roots.
archived-meta.conclusion: Archived quick-chat, wildcard and rejected tournament image remain outside assets. One archived trophy shares the active solid-v3 UUID; not an active import collision.

kenney-source.method: Read CC0 notice; inventory/hash all 195 source-pack files; decode images, inspect Unity archive members without extraction; exact-match 3 selected PNGs and license.
kenney-source.conclusion: Only three source textures selected; package and Unity samples not runtime dependencies. Current official page lists CC0, not a byte-level authentication of this local pack.

legacy-manifest.method: Read retained MIT notice and manifest schema/decisions; inspect then run actual verify-legacy-effect-assets with external source root unset.
legacy-manifest.conclusion: 5 allowed migration candidates / 39 rejected / 0 runtime. Upstream source comparison explicitly skipped; no approval to download/activate old effects.

provenance-manifests.method: Read notices, source pins and runtime/retired rules; verify selected and archived audio paths/lengths/hashes; runtime and two built-package absence checks.
provenance-manifests.conclusion: 4 licensed clips + 48 female + 1 BGM + 1 TTS hash-match. 22 licensed clips archived; 40 male clips retired. Provenance declarations do not establish third-party media rights.

offline-tool-binary.method: Read license/README/plist, inspect Mach-O universal header, decode icon, hash inventory and exclude same-byte tool payloads from builds.
offline-tool-binary.conclusion: rFXGen macOS x86_64/arm64 binary is offline tooling only. Not executed, signed-binary provenance / malicious behavior / source equivalence not verified.

offline-tool-source.method: Inventory all 105 files; inspect root/build entry and embedded zlib notices (raygui/rprand/tinyfiledialogs); decode logos/screenshots; verify no product imports or build payload inclusion.
offline-tool-source.conclusion: Nested vendor C/CMake/Make/VS/GitHub workflows/layouts/styles are outside runtime; not claimed as line-by-line third-party security review or reproducible binary build.

runtime-media.method: Decode tracked image containers; inspect audio formats/payloads; validate all metadata; compare game-assets native bytes, visible pixels and license TextAssets with both existing builds.
runtime-media.conclusion: 60 audio byte copies; 89 bundle images (81 exact pixels, 8 only zero-alpha RGB transformed) per build. One startup image separately covered by startup/package audits. No fresh Cocos build or mobile audiovisual acceptance.

template-media.method: Hash and image-decode startup background and friend-room-share JPEGs; reference previously audited build-template flow.
template-media.conclusion: Two bundled template assets, not fetched externally at runtime. No new WeChat share action.

server-profile-media.method: Decode/hash all 24 bundled profile images; reuse batch36 full catalog/client/server equality and sync-script memory verification.
server-profile-media.conclusion: 24 successful profiles, not 50; source availability is not consent or unrestricted reuse. No requests to QQ/UAPI or live accounts.

art-source.method: Hash/classify every source image/audio/snapshot; image/container checks; licensed archive exact hash checks; reuse batch36 deterministic generator/derived-source verification.
art-source.conclusion: 90 authoring-only files stay outside Cocos assets, including raw TTS and 36 WebPs. This is source/format boundary review, not full pixel-art or voice-rights approval.

retired-artifacts.method: Classify/hash 30 snapshot/audio artifacts; parse 33 metadata snapshots across source/archive groups; repeat actual retirement + reachability guards and reuse batch31 import graph.
retired-artifacts.conclusion: 17 removed modules and 20 archived clips guards pass; no reactivation or deletion. Archived source behavior is excluded from current first-party coverage, not claimed re-audited.

historical-screenshots.method: Decode all 11 image files; inspect true format and nonruntime location.
historical-screenshots.conclusion: All are JPEG bytes with .png extensions in historical documentation only. No current-runtime decode failure inferred; visual/document rendering deferred.

notices.method: Read all nine selected notices completely and compare current registries, files, generator evidence and licensing declarations.
notices.conclusion: One P3 stale third-party usage guide confirmed. Source/rights and historical claims separated from current runtime guarantees.

findings.title: 第三方说明仍把退役男声、快捷语及级牌音效描述为当前能力
findings.evidence: 34/45–49/61/67–79行仍写wildcard运行回退、25个licensed运行音频/2个归档、男声可在设置选择、快捷语按钮及已经不存在的import-niuma-male-audio.mjs。实际为4运行/22归档，male manifest runtimeAllowed=false、40个male音频hash均未入assets或两个现有包；快捷语和wildcard归档且路由退役。
findings.validation: resource-boundaries-39.mjs 对现有文案、缺失导入器、manifest、实际文件/包hash形成一致可重现对照；未调用导入器或复活资源。
findings.impact: 维护者按当前说明寻找不存在的按钮/脚本或误判运行包构成；文档与事实不一致，不导致现有牌局故障。
findings.recommendation: 按真实manifest和退役清单更新THIRD_PARTY的当前使用段，历史能力另作标识；可用校验/生成方式减少同一资源清单多处手写。

concerns.title: 外部声音和默认头像的可访问性与项目授权记录不能独立证明媒体权属
concerns.status: 未验证的发布资料门槛，不推断违法/侵权或已泄露私人信息。
concerns.evidence: NiuMa仓库MIT已保留但无逐音频来源声明；gameabc2/user-supplied资产只记录项目用户允许使用；edge-tts工具许可证不等于在线服务输出条款；24个QQ来源头像/昵称目录未含原权利人授权证明。
concerns.next: 商业使用前由维护者补充有权使用/再分发的材料，必要时替换来源明确素材。审计不抓取更多个人资料或伪造授权。

relatedConcerns: SOURCE-05-C01: 导入器只核HEAD，不核选中文件提交blob；本批只验证本地manifest与资产一致，没有得到干净上游逐文件证明。

limits: Hash/format/boundary checks do not review every pixel, prove rights for imported media, guarantee vendor tool safety, or prove current builds contain every current source change.
Vendor tool source is inventoried and excluded from runtime; it is not line-by-line audited.
Historical DOCX is deferred to document-boundary review.
Image decoding is not visual quality review; afinfo/WAV/OGG checks do not listen to speech or verify WeChat playback.
Current compiled resource payloads are compared, not current application-code freshness.

externalSources.supports: Official page lists CC0; does not authenticate local pack bytes.
Pinned repository MIT notice and copyright; not per-media rights chain.
Pinned source zlib notice; not signed binary provenance.

probeCorrections: 初稿将归档与assets的UUID合并断言，发现归档奖杯共享UUID；按真实Cocos导入边界分别校验，435活动UUID唯一，不误报运行冲突。
文案断言最初使用25 runtime而原文为25 reachable clips，已只修复审计探针；不改产品文件。

finalChecks.inventory: Audit inventory verified: 629/629 first-party files; 39 generated copies; 1068 separately checked boundaries.

limits: 剩余98份文档及1份历史DOCX仍待边界核查；依赖安全公告与完整跨模块总验收另批执行。
PNG/音频元数据检查不是GPU采样、音量/语义/微信兼容性或商用权利鉴定。
现有包来源日期仍为旧构建，资源相等不证明当前629份源文件都在包中。
不执行第三方二进制、联网导入、构建、提交/推送、部署或线上状态查询；仅写本审计目录。
